source: ACR BI-RADS Atlas 5e éd. — Descripteurs Mammographie
topic: Forme, Marges et Densité des Masses
text: Mammographic masses: shape (oval/round/irregular), margins (circumscribed/obscured/microlobulated/indistinct/spiculated), density (high/equal/low/fat). Spiculated or indistinct margins in irregular high-density masses carry highest PPV for invasive carcinoma.
recommendation: Tissue biopsy for spiculated/indistinct irregular masses.

text: Benign: skin, vascular, coarse/popcorn, large rod-like. Suspicious: amorphous, coarse heterogeneous, fine pleomorphic, fine linear/branching — especially grouped, linear or segmental distributions.
recommendation: Stereotactic vacuum-assisted biopsy for suspicious morphology calcifications.

source: ACR BI-RADS Atlas 5e éd. — Descripteurs Échographie
topic: Morphologie et Orientation des Lésions Échographiques
text: US malignancy features: irregular shape, non-parallel orientation (taller-than-wide), non-circumscribed margins (angular/microlobulated/spiculated), markedly hypoechoic, posterior acoustic shadowing. Anechoic round circumscribed masses with enhancement = benign cyst.
recommendation: US-guided core needle biopsy for solid non-circumscribed hypoechoic masses.

source: ACR BI-RADS Atlas 5e éd. — Composition Mammaire
topic: Densité Parenchymateuse et Risque de Masquage
text: Composition A-D: A=almost entirely fatty, B=scattered fibroglandular, C=heterogeneously dense, D=extremely dense. ACR C/D significantly reduces mammographic sensitivity → adjunctive ultrasound warranted.
recommendation: Adjunctive breast ultrasound for ACR C/D dense breasts.

source: ACR BI-RADS Atlas 5e éd. — Catégories 1 et 2
text: BI-RADS 1: completely negative, 0% PPM. BI-RADS 2: definite benign (simple cyst, stable intramammary lymph node, vascular calcification), 0% PPM. Both: routine screening intervals, no short-term recall.

BI-RADS 3: >0% to ≤2% PPM. Classic: non-palpable circumscribed solid mass on baseline, focal asymmetry, round calcifications. Management: short-interval follow-up (unilateral 6 months, bilateral at 12 and 24 months).

BI-RADS 4: suspicious, biopsy required. 4A: >2%-≤10% (low suspicion, partially circumscribed solid). 4B: >10%-≤50% (moderate). 4C: >50%-<95% (high, irregular indistinct solid mass or fine pleomorphic calcifications).
recommendation: Histopathological diagnosis via image-guided core needle biopsy.

text: BI-RADS 5: ≥95% PPM. Typical: irregular spiculated high-density mass ± suspicious microcalcifications; non-parallel hypoechoic mass with acoustic shadowing. Biopsy mandatory; oncologic surgical planning initiated.
recommendation: Immediate core needle biopsy + surgical oncology consultation.

topic: Arbitrage en cas de Discordance entre Modalités
text: Discordant mammo/US assessments: management governed by HIGHEST BI-RADS category. A suspicious finding on either modality warrants targeted tissue sampling regardless of the other modality's benign assessment.
recommendation: Highest-suspicion modality governs; perform targeted biopsy.
